title: Simple Mannequins
description: Datapack that adds Mannequins To Survival
body:
## A simple and easy way to bring player models to minecraft survival!
### **INSTRUCTIONS ON HOW TO USE SIMPLE MANNEQUINS:**

1. You can make player heads by crafting 8 leather around a skeleton skull.
2. You can name the player head in a anvil to **ANY** player in Minecraft!
3. Then you can put the player head on a armor stand's head.
4. You can get back the armor stand and the player head by punching the mannequin.
